en-US.name: K4 Control
en-US.summary: Voice control for an Elecraft K4 transceiver on the local network.
en-US.description:
Sends Elecraft CAT commands to a K4 transceiver over its network control port by way of a bridge running on the operator's own home network. Say "Alexa, tell radio control to turn off the radio" to place the K4 in standby.

This is a private skill intended for the station owner only. It is not certified for public distribution.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell radio control to turn off the radio
Alexa, ask radio control to turn on the radio
Alexa, ask radio control if the radio is on

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Private skill. Requires a K4 Echo Control bridge running on the operator's home network.
